## Coding Style Preferences

- Write code in a practical, human style consistent with an engineer with around 5 years of MERN stack experience and overall 9+ years of experience in software development.
- Prefer clear naming, straightforward control flow, and small reusable units over clever abstractions.
- Keep comments minimal and useful; avoid noisy or redundant comments.
- Avoid repetitive boilerplate patterns and generic placeholder wording.
- Keep code production-oriented and readable for team handoff.
